# whisper.cpp and Whisper model

- Runtime source: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp
- Runtime version: v1.9.2 (`whisper-bin-x64.zip`)
- Model source: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp
- Model: `ggml-base-q5_1.bin` (multilingual Base Q5_1)
- License: MIT

Piora downloads these pinned artifacts during the desktop build, verifies
their SHA-256 digests, and bundles them as application resources. No model or
runtime download occurs when the packaged application is used.
